mapper.insert: INSERT INTO environment_reading (source, wind_speed, wind_direction, temperature, humidity, pressure, noise, observed_at) VALUES (#{source}, #{windSpeed}, #{windDirection}, #{temperature}, #{humidity}, #{pressure}, #{noise}, #{observedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, source, wind_speed as windSpeed, wind_direction as windDirection, temperature, humidity, pressure, noise, observed_at as observedAt, created_at as createdAt FROM environment_reading ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, source, wind_speed as windSpeed, wind_direction as windDirection, temperature, humidity, pressure, noise, observed_at as observedAt, created_at as createdAt FROM environment_reading ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
